prompts.title: JSON 三联画 提示词：温馨 卧室 场景
prompts.description: 一个结构化的 JSON 提示词，用于 Nano Banana 2，通过 Gemini 生成一个垂直三联画构图（三幅堆叠的画面），描绘一位单身女性在温馨的居家卧室环境中，处于黄金时段。该提示词强调所有三幅画面中 100% 一致的面部身份、柔和的灯光以及电影般的质感。
prompts.content: Create a triptych composition with vertical layout of three stacked frames. Same subject, same environment, same lighting across all frames. A single woman in her mid-20s with 100% consistent facial identity across all three frames. She has natural, smooth skin with visible pores and subtle imperfections, blue eyes that are expressive and softly reflective under golden hour light, and long, voluminous, smooth flowing hair that falls naturally across the face, partially obscuring facial features in all frames. She wears light, minimal, romantic makeup with soft blush, subtle highlighter, natural lips, and lightly defined eyes. She wears a minimalist strappy top in soft, slightly textured fabric with natural folds, in muted neutral tones of beige, cream, and soft taupe. A silver ear cuff is visible. The setting is an intimate home bedroom with a soft bed featuring neutral-toned sheets and a plush pillow supporting her upper body, with slightly wrinkled fabric for realism. Golden hour sunlight enters from a side window, creating soft, directional, warm light with streaks across face and body, producing muted golden hues with gentle contrast. The atmosphere is romantic, intimate, and calm with muted palette, soft highlights, subdued shadows, and visible film grain for cinematic texture. Use cinematic, editorial photography style with a 50mm prime lens, shallow depth of field with soft background blur, sharp focus on key facial features in each frame, fine film grain, and soft highlight roll-off with no harsh clipping. TOP FRAME: Close-up portrait in first-person selfie perspective, lying on bed propped up by pillow, head slightly turned sideways toward camera, soft romantic introspective gaze, a streak of golden sunlight crosses her face diagonally, silver ear cuff visible, hair partially covering face, eyes softly engaged with camera, tight face crop with slight shoulder visibility. CENTER FRAME: Extreme close-up of lips, hand gently brushing over lips with soft, slow, sensual but subtle motion, natural lip texture, soft light reflecting on lips, fingers partially in frame with natural positioning, hair strands crossing frame slightly, soft golden highlights with muted shadows, sharp focus on lips with shallow depth of field. BOTTOM FRAME: Close-up of eyes from side angle, same bed position, head tilted back slightly, side profile focusing on eyes, golden sunlight streak illuminating the eyes directly, blue eyes glowing under sunlight, hair partially obscuring one eye, soft shadow gradients across face, sharp focus on eyes with blurred background. Style: Romantic cinematic editorial with influences from film photography, luxury fashion editorials, and intimate lifestyle portraiture. Color palette: muted warm tones, soft beige, gold, cream, and subtle shadows. Post-processing: visible analog film grain, low to medium contrast, slightly desaturated, soft bloom effect on highlights, lifted shadows for softness. No anime or illustration, strictly photorealistic. Facial identity must remain identical across all frames. Avoid over-smoothing, preserve skin texture. Three distinct frames clearly separated but visually cohesive.

场景设定在一个私密的居家卧室，一张柔软的床上铺着中性色调的床单，一个毛绒枕头支撑着她的上半身，略带褶皱的织物增加了真实感。黄金时段的阳光从侧窗射入，营造出柔和、有方向性的暖光，光束掠过脸部和身体，产生柔和的金色调和轻微的对比。氛围浪漫、私密、宁静，色调柔和，高光柔和，阴影内敛，可见胶片颗粒，营造电影般的质感。采用电影感、杂志编辑风格的摄影，使用 50mm 定焦镜头，浅景深，背景柔和虚化，每个画框中关键面部特征清晰对焦，精细的胶片颗粒，柔和的高光过渡，无生硬的过曝。

**顶部画框：** 第一人称自拍视角下的特写肖像，躺在床上，枕头支撑着，头部略微侧向镜头，柔和、浪漫、内省的凝视，一束金色阳光斜穿过她的脸庞，银色耳骨夹可见，头发部分遮盖脸部，眼睛柔和地与镜头互动，脸部特写，略可见肩膀。

**中部画框：** 嘴唇的超特写，手指以柔和、缓慢、感性而微妙的动作轻抚嘴唇，自然的唇部纹理，柔和的光线反射在嘴唇上，手指部分入画，姿态自然，几缕发丝略微穿过画面，柔和的金色高光与内敛的阴影，嘴唇清晰对焦，景深较浅。

**底部画框：** 侧面角度的眼睛特写，相同的卧姿，头部略微后仰，侧脸特写，聚焦于眼睛，金色阳光束直接照亮眼睛，蓝色的眼睛在阳光下闪耀，头发部分遮挡一只眼睛，脸部柔和的阴影渐变，眼睛清晰对焦，背景虚化。

**风格：** 浪漫电影感编辑风格，融合了胶片摄影、奢华时尚杂志和私密生活肖像的元素。
**色彩：** 柔和的暖色调，包括柔和的米色、金色、奶油色和细微的阴影。
**后期处理：** 可见模拟胶片颗粒，低到中等对比度，轻微去饱和，高光处有柔和的光晕效果，提亮阴影以增加柔和度。非动漫或插画风格，严格写实。面部特征在所有画框中必须保持一致。避免过度平滑，保留皮肤纹理。三个独立的画框清晰分隔，但视觉上保持连贯。
